notes: Closes issue #89 by supplying deterministic bounded retry pacing hints for retryable Instagram provider failures that omit Retry-After.
Valid provider Retry-After values remain authoritative over fallback timing.
The Instagram adapter remains single-attempt; the existing outer publishing planner is the only retry executor.
No OAuth/provider configuration, credential, permission, publishing policy, UI, database, deployment or production state changes are in scope.

approvals.rationale: Owner instructed go next after merging VS-61. Repository authority identified issue #89 as the next unblocked FR-15 maintenance item rather than expanding into an unapproved product capability.
Retry classification and bounded pacing hints stay within existing FR-15 provider-resilience policy; no new provider scope, permissions or production setting is introduced.
Go next authorizes bounded implementation, regression tests and exact-head certification gates. Merge, deployment, provider activation and release remain separately gated.
Requires Product Intake, Security baseline and CI on one frozen candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
No deployment or provider activation is authorized by implementation or merge approval.
